pairs: And so Daniel was living with the king,
et honoratus super omnes amicos ejus.
and he was honored above all his friends.
Erat quoque idolum apud Babylonios nomine Bel:
Now there was an idol with the Babylonians named Bel.
et impendebantur in eo per dies singulos similæ artabæ duodecim,
And each day there was expended on him twelve great measures of fine flour,
et ibat per singulos dies adorare eum:
and went each day to adore him,
And the king said to him,
“Because I do not worship idols made with hands,
and who holds power over all flesh.”
And the king said to him,
Non videtur tibi esse Bel vivens deus?
“Does not Bel seem to you to be a living god?
an non vides quanta comedat et bibat quotidie?
Do you not see how much he eats and drinks every day?”
for this one is clay on the inside and brass on the outside,
Et iratus rex vocavit sacerdotes ejus,
And the king, being angry, called for his priests and said to them,
et ait eis: Nisi dixeritis mihi quis est qui comedat impensas has,
“If you do not tell me who it is that has eaten these expenses,
Si autem ostenderitis quoniam Bel comedat hæc,
But if you can show that Bel has eaten these,
because he has blasphemed against Bel.”
And Daniel said to the king,
“Let it be according to your word.”
Now the priests of Bel were seventy,
Et venit rex cum Daniele in templum Bel.
And the king went with Daniel into the temple of Bel.
And the priests of Bel said,
“Behold, we are going out, and you,
and seal it with your ring.
And when you have entered in the morning,
nisi inveneris omnia comesta a Bel,
if you have not found that Bel has consumed all,
vel Daniel qui mentitus est adversum nos.
or else Daniel will, who has lied against us.”
Contemnebant autem, quia fecerant sub mensa absconditum introitum,
But they had no concern because they had made a secret entrance under the table,
et per illum ingrediebantur semper, et devorabant ea.
and they always went in through it and devoured those things.
Factum est igitur postquam egressi sunt illi,
And so it happened, after they had departed,
that the king set the foods before Bel,
et cribravit per totum templum coram rege:
and he sifted them throughout the temple in the sight of the king,
and, as they left, they shut the door,
and after sealing it with the king’s ring, they departed.
Sacerdotes autem ingressi sunt nocte juxta consuetudinem suam,
But the priests entered by night,
and they ate and drank everything.
But the king arose at first light,
And as soon as he had opened the door,
the king stared at the table,
and cried out with a loud voice,
et non est apud te dolus quisquam.
and there is not any deceit with you.”
et tenuit regem ne ingrederetur intro:
and he held back the king, so that he would not enter,
and their wives, and their sons,
et ostenderunt ei abscondita ostiola, per quæ ingrediebantur, et consumebant quæ erant super mensam.
and they showed him the secret doors through which they entered and consumed the things that were on the table.
Occidit ergo illos rex, et tradidit Bel in potestatem Danielis:
Therefore, the king slaughtered them and delivered Bel into the power of Daniel,
qui subvertit eum, et templum ejus.
who overturned him and his temple.
Et erat draco magnus in loco illo,
And there was a great dragon in that place,
And the king said to Daniel,
Ecce nunc non potes dicere quia iste non sit deus vivens:
“Behold, now you cannot say that this is not a living god;
for he is the living God.
iste autem non est deus vivens.
But that one is not a living god.
et interficiam draconem absque gladio et fuste.
and I will execute this dragon without sword or club.”
And he made lumps and put them into the dragon’s mouth,
When the Babylonians had heard this,
And gathering together against the king,
and he has slaughtered the priests.”
Et dixerunt cum venissent ad regem:
And when they came to the king,
otherwise we will execute you and your house.”
Vidit ergo rex quod irruerent in eum vehementer:
Thus the king saw that they pressured him vehemently, and so,
Qui miserunt eum in lacum leonum,
And they cast him into the den of lions,
and he was there for six days.
Porro in lacu erant leones septem,
Furthermore, in the den there were seven lions,
et dabantur eis duo corpora quotidie,
and they had given to them two carcasses every day,
et tunc non data sunt eis,
but then they were not given to them,
so that they would devour Daniel.
Erat autem Habacuc propheta in Judæa,
Now there was in Judea a prophet called Habakkuk,
and he had cooked a small meal and had broken bread in a bowl,
and he was going into the field,
et ibat in campum ut ferret messoribus.
to bring it to the harvesters.
And the angel of the Lord said to Habakkuk,
Fer prandium quod habes in Babylonem Danieli,
“Carry the meal that you have into Babylon, to Daniel,
who is in the lions’ den.”
and I do not know the den.”
Et apprehendit eum angelus Domini in vertice ejus,
And the angel of the Lord seized him by the top of his head,
et portavit eum capillo capitis sui,
and carried him by the hair of his head,
posuitque eum in Babylone supra lacum in impetu spiritus sui.
and set him in Babylon, over the den, by the force of his spirit.
tolle prandium quod misit tibi Deus.
take the dinner that God has sent you.”
and you have not abandoned those who love you.”
Porro angelus Domini restituit Habacuc confestim in loco suo.
And then the angel of the Lord immediately returned Habakkuk to his place.
Venit ergo rex die septimo ut lugeret Danielem:
And so, on the seventh day, the king came to mourn Daniel.
And he came to the den,
et ecce Daniel sedens in medio leonum.
Daniel was sitting in the midst of the lions.
And the king cried out with a loud voice,
O Lord, the God of Daniel.”
Et extraxit eum de lacu leonum.
And he pulled him out of the lions’ den.
those who had been the cause of his downfall,
et devorati sunt in momento coram eo.
and they were devoured in a moment before him.
Paveant omnes habitantes in universa terra Deum Danielis:
“Let all the inhabitants of the whole earth fear the God of Daniel.
faciens signa et mirabilia in terra:
working signs and miracles on earth,
qui liberavit Danielem de lacu leonum.
who has freed Daniel from the lions’ den.”
